notes.title: Fuel Station Simulator - Copy?
notes.content:
Unfortunately, we recently discovered that another developer has renamed their game to match ours.
Although we have opened a case with Steam, it is likely not something we can take action against – nor do we intend to.

Our focus is on creating a new game, not on questionable tactics from competitors.

We have no connection whatsoever to the other game with the same name.

notes.title: Happy new year! (and some quick news..) ;-)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995273/d2c19c6bc91f796d8df62c647f12b87b95416a6f.jpg[/img]

At the end of the year, there hasn't been much news about Fuel Station Simulator.

We want to thank everyone for the many wishlists and are excited to announce that the release is just around the corner.

We hope you’ll have as much fun playing the game as we had creating it.

To wrap things up, we wish you a wonderful and healthy 2025 for you and your loved ones.

See you soon (at the pump)!

notes.title: The first step is always the hardest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995273/841754e12765a10f72b931cd94ceaf316972e465.png[/img]

Here’s a little preview of what it might look like when you start your gas station.

As mentioned before, every beginning is difficult!

It's up to you to expand the gas station and create your own (gas station) empire.

Release is getting closer!

notes.title: We told you, we'll keep you busy!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995273/e55efadac6705f154a2ef4e21a114645bf7e46f9.png[/img]

Of course, the state visible in the picture is not how you will find it in the game.

However, we wanted to give you a little update: 
We are making great progress and eagerly anticipating our release. 

[b]Thank you so much for all the wishlists. You are amazing![/b]

notes.title: Fuel Station Simulator storepage live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

It has already been very exciting for us up to this point. But yesterday it finally happened and our store page went online, which was a very big step for us.

Here we want to give you the opportunity to get news about the game already now, as well as to exchange ideas with each other and to get in touch with us. We are very much looking forward to everything that is happening now!
